name: Star-Lord (Stellar-Forged)

abilityDetails.Fractured Power Bar: Şampiyon, elindeki güç barına göre farklı özel saldırı türlerini belirli olasılıklarla kullanır.
abilityDetails.Vulnerability: Fiziksel Direnci ve Enerji Direncini belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Combo Wave: Her vuruş +1 combo metre kazandırır; kritik vuruşlar ek +5 combo metre verir.
abilityDetails.Guaranteed Crits: Tüm vuruşlar garanti kritik vuruş olur.

signatureAbility:
While a Combo Shield is Active
Precision Buffs on Star-Lord expire [15 -50]% slower.
During Star-Lord's Special Attacks, he takes [25 - 75]% reduced damage from all sources.

abilitySections.title: A Lord Forged in ISO - Always Active
content: Star-Lord's Stellar Enhancement grants him a Fractured Power Bar.
The hit following a Critical Hit has 10% increased Combat Power Rate.
The duration of Star-Lord's effects all benefit from Class Advantage. The increased duration for Class Advantage is shown in brackets for each effect.

abilitySections.title: Combo Meter
content: At the start of each fight, Star-Lord gains a Combo Shield Passive for 30 (42) seconds.
Light and Heavy Attacks grant +1 Combo Meter.
Each time Star-Lord crosses a Combo Meter threshold of 20, he gains an indefinite Persistent Cruelty Charge, increasing Critical Damage Rating by +[493.9]. Max stacks: 20.
+[127.62] Attack Rating for each Persistent Charge.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attack
content: Each hit grants a Precision Buff, granting +[964.29] Critical Rating for 15 (21) seconds. Max stacks: 2.

abilitySections.title: Element Gun - Rotation
content: Star-Lord's Element Gun rotates through four elemental modes, starting with Earth, and rotating to the next Element in order each time the Element Gun is fired during Special Attacks 1 or 3.
The Element is also rotated when Star-Lord lands a second Medium Attack.

abilitySections.title: Element Gun Effects - Non-Stacking
content: Earth: Inflict a Vulnerability Debuff for 15 (21) seconds, reducing Physical and Energy Resistance by [1,500].
Fire: Inflict a Critical Incinerate Debuff dealing [6,381] Energy Damage multiplied by Star-Lord's Critical Damage Multiplier over 15 (21) seconds.
Water: Gain a Combo Wave Passive for 10 (14) seconds.
Air: Pause all other Element Gun effects for 10 (14) seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - Element Gun
content: The last hit fires the Element Gun in its current elemental mode.
If this attack is a Well-Timed Special, the next Element in order is also activated.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - Rocket Kick
content: On activation, gain a Combo Shield Passive for 20 (28) seconds.
This attack is a Guaranteed Critical Hit.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - Heroic Blast
content: Fire the Element Gun in its current elemental mode.
Each other Element can also activate with each chance matching Star-Lord's current Critical Hit Chance.
Refresh all Element Gun effects.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - While a Combo Shield is Active
content: Precision Buffs on Star-Lord expire [15 -50]% slower.
During Star-Lord's Special Attacks, he takes [25 - 75]% reduced damage from all sources.
